- name: social_media_reporting__twitter_posts_reporting
      description: Standardizes organic Twitter tweet metrics into one row per tweet and account with summed counts, averaged engagement rate, and canonical URL
      grain: One row per post_id (organic_tweet_id) per page_id (account_id)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_social_media__twitter_organic_tweets
      business_logic: '- Input: include only records where organic_tweet_id is present. - Grouping: aggregate by organic_tweet_id and account_id to form post-level groups. - created_timestamp: earliest date in the group; null if all dates are missing. - post_message: the lexicographically last non-null tweet_text in the group; if all are missing, result is null; original casing and whitespace are preserved. - page_name: for each row, choose the first non-blank among screen_name, user_name, then account_id as text (blank strings treated as missing); from these per-row candidates, select the lexicographically last value in the group; may be null; original casing and whitespace are preserved. - platform: set to the literal value twitter. - Metrics aggregation: clicks, impressions, likes, retweets, replies, app_clicks, url_clicks, and qualified_impressions are summed per group, ignoring missing values. If a metric has no values in a group, it remains null at this stage. - Renames: shares is the sum of retweets; comments is the sum of replies. - engagement_rate: average of engagement_rate within the group, ignoring missing values; remains null if no values exist. - Final outputs: - page_id is account_id. - post_id is the text form of organic_tweet_id. - clicks, impressions, likes, shares, comments, app_clicks, url_clicks, and qualified_impressions default to 0 when null. - engagement_rate defaults to 0.0 when null. - post_url is built as https://twitter.com/{page_name}/status/{post_id}; if page_name is null, post_url is null; no URL encoding; casing preserved. - calculated_engagement_rate: if impressions (after defaulting) is greater than 0, compute (likes + shares + comments) divided by impressions using the zero-defaulted values; otherwise return 0.0; result is floating point. - Output: one row per (account_id, organic_tweet_id).'
      columns:
      - name: page_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Twitter account_id for the group; may be null
      - name: page_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Chosen as the lexicographically last per-row candidate (screen_name, else user_name, else account_id as text); may be null
      - name: post_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organic tweet identifier as text; not null
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: post_message
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lexicographically last non-null tweet_text across the group
      - name: created_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest observed date for the tweet; null if all dates are missing
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Constant value 'twitter'
      - name: clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of clicks across the group; missing values ignored; defaults to 0
      - name: impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of impressions across the group; missing values ignored; defaults to 0
      - name: likes
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of likes across the group; missing values ignored; defaults to 0
      - name: shares
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of retweets across the group; missing values ignored; defaults to 0
      - name: comments
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of replies across the group; missing values ignored; defaults to 0
      - name: post_url
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Built as https://twitter.com/{page_name}/status/{post_id}; null if page_name is null; no URL encoding
      - name: app_clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of app_clicks across the group; missing values ignored; defaults to 0
      - name: url_clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of url_clicks across the group; missing values ignored; defaults to 0
      - name: qualified_impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of qualified_impressions across the group; missing values ignored; defaults to 0
      - name: engagement_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average engagement_rate across the group; defaults to 0.0 if no values
      - name: calculated_engagement_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Computed as (likes + shares + comments) divided by impressions using zero-defaulted values; 0.0 when impressions is 0 or missing

- name: social_media_reporting__youtube_videos_reporting
      description: Standardizes YouTube videos to a unified post-level schema and derives ratios for the last two years of videos
      grain: One row per post_id (video_id)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_social_media__youtube_videos
      business_logic: '- Source and filter: use staging.stg_social_media__youtube_videos rows where video_id is present and video_published_at is within the last two years. - Mapping: - page_id: channel_id cast to text; nulls remain null. - page_name: channel title; if missing, set to ''Unknown Channel''. - post_id: video_id cast to text (always present due to filter). - created_timestamp: video_published_at (always present due to filter). - platform: constant ''youtube''. - post_message: video_description cast to text; original casing and spacing preserved. - clicks and impressions: both set to the video''s views; views come from the source clicks field; default to 0 when missing. - likes, comments, shares: interactions default to 0 when missing; shares use the source estimated_shares. - post_url: passed through from source; may represent a thumbnail URL; may be null. - privacy_status: passed through. - channel_subscribers and channel_total_videos: default to 0; total_videos is 0 in the current SQL. - calculated_engagement_rate: - Use the provided engagement_rate when it is positive; otherwise, if views > 0, compute (likes + comments + shares) divided by views; else 0.0; no rounding or capping. - Derived ratios: - views_per_subscriber: clicks divided by channel_subscribers when subscribers > 0, else 0.0. - likes_per_view_ratio: likes divided by clicks when clicks > 0, else 0.0. - No aggregation, de-duplication, or ordering; rows mirror the filtered source.'
      columns:
      - name: page_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Channel identifier cast to text; nulls preserved
      - name: page_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Channel title with fallback to 'Unknown Channel' when missing
      - name: post_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: YouTube video identifier cast to text; non-null due to the source filter on video_id
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: post_message
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Video description text; original casing and whitespace preserved; may be null
      - name: created_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Video publish timestamp limited to the last two years by the filter; non-null
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Constant platform label 'youtube'
      - name: clicks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: YouTube views treated as clicks; sourced from the staging clicks field; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: impressions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Proxy equal to clicks (views); defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: likes
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total likes default to 0 when missing
      - name: shares
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Estimated shares from the source estimated_shares; default to 0 when missing
      - name: comments
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total comments default to 0 when missing
      - name: post_url
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: URL passed through from source (may be a thumbnail URL); may be null
      - name: calculated_engagement_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Engagement rate: use provided value when positive; otherwise (likes + comments + shares) divided by views when views > 0; else 0.0; no rounding'
        tests:
        - calculated_engagement_rate >= 0
      - name: privacy_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Video privacy status passed through; may be null
      - name: channel_subscribers
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Channel subscribers default to 0 when missing
      - name: channel_total_videos
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Total videos default to 0; currently always 0 in this model
      - name: views_per_subscriber
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Clicks divided by channel_subscribers when subscribers > 0; otherwise 0.0; no rounding
      - name: likes_per_view_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Likes divided by clicks when clicks > 0; otherwise 0.0; no rounding

- name: social_media_reporting__retention_kpis
      description: Weekly retention KPIs by platform using posting-activity cohorts over a fixed 13-week window
      grain: One row per platform per cohort_week per week_offset
      source_models:
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__facebook_posts_reporting
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__instagram_posts_reporting
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__linkedin_posts_reporting
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__twitter_posts_reporting
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__youtube_videos_reporting
      business_logic: '- Inputs: - Union page activity from the five source models; only keep rows where created_timestamp is present. - Assign platform as one of: "facebook", "instagram", "linkedin", "twitter", "youtube". - Weekly normalization: - Bucket activity into ISO weeks starting Monday 00:00. - A page is considered active in a week if it posts at least once; multiple posts in the same week do not increase the activity count. - Cohorts: - For each (page_id, platform), set cohort_week to the earliest week with activity. - For each (platform, cohort_week), cohort_pages is the number of unique pages in that cohort. - Observation spine: - Generate week_offset values from 0 to 12 inclusive. - For each cohort, create 13 rows and set target_week to the start of the week that is week_offset weeks after cohort_week; when week_offset = 0, target_week equals cohort_week. - Activity presence: - Build distinct (platform, week, page_id) combinations so each active page-week is counted once. - Retention: - For each spine row, retained_pages is the number of unique pages active on the platform in target_week; this is not limited to members of the cohort. - KPI: - retention_rate = retained_pages divided by cohort_pages when cohort_pages > 0; otherwise 0.0. - No rounding; stored as double precision; values may exceed 1.0 due to the numerator scope. - Output: - Emit platform, cohort_week, week_offset, target_week, cohort_pages, retained_pages, retention_rate. - No explicit ordering is applied.'
      columns:
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Platform name in lowercase: facebook, instagram, linkedin, twitter, or youtube'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: cohort_week
        data_type: DATE
        description: Start date (Monday) of the first week the page is active for the platform
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: week_offset
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of weeks since cohort_week, inclusive 0 to 12
        tests:
        - not_null
        - week_offset BETWEEN 0 AND 12
      - name: target_week
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Start-of-week timestamp at week_offset weeks after cohort_week; equals cohort_week when offset is 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: cohort_pages
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique pages in the cohort for each (platform, cohort_week)
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: retained_pages
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique pages active on the platform in target_week; one count per page-week; not limited to cohort members
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: retention_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Ratio of retained_pages to cohort_pages; if cohort_pages is 0 then 0.0; no rounding; may exceed 1.0
        tests:
        - not_null
        - retention_rate >= 0

- name: social_media_reporting__rollup_report
      description: Unified cross-platform post/video rollup with standardized metrics, platform-specific quality score, rankings, and recent-window filtering
      grain: One row per platform + page_id + post_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__facebook_posts_reporting
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__instagram_posts_reporting
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__linkedin_posts_reporting
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__twitter_posts_reporting
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__youtube_videos_reporting
      business_logic: '- Union all five platform models with a platform label: facebook, instagram, linkedin, twitter, youtube; select page_id, page_name, post_id, post_message, created_timestamp, clicks, impressions, likes, shares, comments, post_url. For YouTube, the upstream shares value maps to the unified shares position. - Filter out rows with NULL created_timestamp. - Apply recent data windows relative to the current date: - LinkedIn: keep the last 4 years. - All other platforms: keep the last 2 years. - Standardize content fields: - post_message: default NULL to empty string "". - post_url: default NULL to empty string "". - Standardize metric fields (clicks, impressions, likes, shares, comments): default NULL to 0; no aggregation or deduplication is performed. - Compute engagement_rate: - If impressions > 0: (clicks + likes + shares + comments) / impressions. - Otherwise: 0.0. - No rounding or capping; always non-null and may exceed 1.0. - Compute content_quality_score by platform: - facebook: 75 if impressions > 0, else 50. - instagram: 90 if impressions > 0, else 50. - twitter: 80 if impressions > 0, else 50. - youtube: 95 if clicks > 0, else 50. - linkedin: 70 if impressions > 0, else 50. - Rankings (computed after the above filtering): - daily_platform_rank: within each platform and calendar day of created_timestamp, assign a 1-based rank by sorting impressions descending; ties get arbitrary order. - platform_lifetime_rank: within each platform across the filtered dataset, assign a 1-based rank by sorting impressions descending; ties get arbitrary order. - Final result ordering for display: created_timestamp descending, then engagement_rate descending.'
      columns:
      - name: page_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source page/account identifier within a platform
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: page_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source page/account display name; may be null
      - name: post_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source post/media identifier within platform and page
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: created_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Post/media publish timestamp; rows with NULL are excluded
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Platform label: facebook, instagram, linkedin, twitter, youtube'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: post_message
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Post/media text; NULL defaults to empty string; casing and whitespace preserved
      - name: post_url
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Canonical post/media URL; NULL defaults to empty string; casing and whitespace preserved
      - name: clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total clicks; NULL defaults to 0; used in engagement_rate and YouTube quality rule
      - name: impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total impressions; NULL defaults to 0; denominator for engagement_rate and several quality rules
      - name: likes
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total likes; NULL defaults to 0; included in engagement_rate numerator
      - name: shares
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total shares; NULL defaults to 0; included in engagement_rate numerator; for YouTube, upstream shares are used
      - name: comments
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total comments; NULL defaults to 0; included in engagement_rate numerator
      - name: engagement_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If impressions > 0, (clicks + likes + shares + comments) / impressions; else 0.0; not rounded or capped; never null
      - name: content_quality_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Platform rule-based score: FB 75 if impressions > 0; IG 90 if impressions > 0; TW 80 if impressions > 0; YT 95 if clicks > 0; LI 70 if impressions > 0; otherwise 50'
      - name: daily_platform_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: 1-based rank within each platform and calendar day by impressions descending; ties receive arbitrary order
      - name: platform_lifetime_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: 1-based rank within each platform across the filtered dataset by impressions descending; ties receive arbitrary order

- name: stg_social_media__twitter_user_history
      description: "Cleaned and standardized Twitter user profile attributes for safe downstream joins and reporting."
      source_table: raw.twitter_user_history
      columns:
        - name: id
          data_type: BIGINT
          constraints: [not_null]
        - name: _fivetran_synced
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
        - name: screen_name
          data_type: VARCHAR
          constraints: [not_null]
          description: >
            Best-effort cleaning to keep only [A-Za-z0-9_]; rows with NULL/blank or harmful characters are removed.
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "screen_name = CASE WHEN screen_name IS NULL OR TRIM(screen_name) = '' THEN NULL ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(screen_name, '[^A-Za-z0-9_]', '') END"
              on_failure: correct
            - rule: "screen_name IS NOT NULL AND NOT (screen_name RLIKE '[!@#$%^&*()+=<>?}{|,]')"
              on_failure: delete_row
        - name: url
          data_type: VARCHAR
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "url IS NULL OR url RLIKE '^https?://[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}(/.*)?'"
              on_failure: nullify_field
            - rule: "url IS NULL OR (url RLIKE '^(https?://)?[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}(/.*)?' AND url RLIKE '^https?://')"
              on_failure: correct
        - name: created_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
        - name: followers_count
          data_type: BIGINT
        - name: following_count
          data_type: BIGINT
          description: "Renamed from friends_count."
        - name: listed_count
          data_type: BIGINT
        - name: favourites_count
          data_type: BIGINT
        - name: statuses_count
          data_type: BIGINT
        - name: verified
          data_type: BOOLEAN
        - name: protected
          data_type: BOOLEAN
          description: "Derived from protected_user: TRUE if protected_user=TRUE else FALSE."
        - name: default_profile
          data_type: BOOLEAN
        - name: default_profile_image
          data_type: BOOLEAN
        - name: location
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: description
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: time_zone
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: lang
          data_type: VARCHAR

- name: stg_social_media__youtube_videos
      description: "YouTube videos staged with standardized fields and basic derived metrics; recent 2-year window."
      source_table: raw.youtube_video
      notes:
        - "Include only videos with view data: statistics_view_count IS NOT NULL."
        - "Restrict to last 2 years: snippet_published_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '2 years'."
        - "post_url is constructed as https://img.youtube.com/vi/{video_id}/default.jpg."
        - "All numeric metrics default to 0 when NULL."
        - "impressions and clicks both mirror statistics_view_count per SQL."
      columns:
        - name: video_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "CAST(id AS VARCHAR)."
        - name: video_published_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "snippet_published_at."
        - name: video_title
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: video_description
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: channel_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: channel_title
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: page_name
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: post_url
          data_type: VARCHAR
          description: "Thumbnail URL used as post URL: https://img.youtube.com/vi/{video_id}/default.jpg."
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "post_url RLIKE '^https://img.youtube.com/vi/.+/default.jpg'"
              on_failure: correct
        - name: privacy_status
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: clicks
          data_type: BIGINT
        - name: impressions
          data_type: BIGINT
          description: "COALESCE(statistics_view_count, 0) — estimated as views in SQL."
        - name: likes
          data_type: BIGINT
        - name: comments
          data_type: BIGINT
        - name: estimated_shares
          data_type: BIGINT
          description: >
            CASE WHEN statistics_like_count > 10 THEN FLOOR(statistics_like_count / 10) ELSE 0 END.
        - name: subscribers
          data_type: BIGINT
          description: "COALESCE(channel_info.channel_subscribers, 0)."
        - name: engagement_rate
          data_type: DOUBLE
          description: "CASE WHEN impressions > 0 THEN (likes + comments + estimated_shares)::DOUBLE / impressions ELSE 0.0 END."
        - name: _fivetran_synced
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          description: "_fivetran_synced from raw.youtube_video."

- name: tiktok_ads__ad_report

      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_report_hourly (stat_time_hour, source_relation, ad_id, impressions, clicks, spend, reach, conversion, likes, comments, shares, profile_visits, follows, video_watched_2_s, video_watched_6_s, video_views_p_25, video_views_p_50, video_views_p_75, real_time_conversion, total_purchase_value, total_sales_lead_value)
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_history_latest (ad_id, ad_name, ad_group_id, advertiser_id, campaign_id, source_relation)
      - intermediate.int_tiktok_ads__ad_group_history_latest (ad_group_id, ad_group_name, advertiser_id, interest_category, gender, audience_type, budget, source_relation)

      grain: One row per unique combination of date_day, placement, account_id, account_name, campaign_id, campaign_name, line_item_id, line_item_name, promoted_tweet_id, tweet_id, tweet_name, tweet_full_text, base_url, url_host, url_path, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_content, utm_term, expanded_url, display_url, currency
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_twitter_ads__promoted_tweet_report_base
      - intermediate.int_twitter_ads__promoted_tweets
      - intermediate.int_twitter_ads__tweets
      - intermediate.int_twitter_ads__tweet_url_first
      - intermediate.int_twitter_ads__line_items
      - intermediate.int_twitter_ads__campaigns
      - intermediate.int_twitter_ads__accounts
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_twitter_ads__promoted_tweet_report_base r (daily metrics by placement). - Join dimensions (LEFT JOINs in the query): • r.promoted_tweet_id → intermediate.int_twitter_ads__promoted_tweets pt • pt.tweet_id → intermediate.int_twitter_ads__tweets t • pt.tweet_id → intermediate.int_twitter_ads__tweet_url_first u (first URL per tweet) • pt.line_item_id → intermediate.int_twitter_ads__line_items li • li.campaign_id → intermediate.int_twitter_ads__campaigns c • r.account_id → intermediate.int_twitter_ads__accounts a - Apply filter: require u.expanded_url to be non-NULL, which effectively makes the join to u (and thus to pt) act as an inner join; other joins remain left and may yield NULL attributes. - Group by all selected dimensions exactly: date_day, placement, account_id, account_name, campaign_id, campaign_name, line_item_id, line_item_name, promoted_tweet_id, tweet_id, tweet_name, tweet_full_text, base_url, url_host, url_path, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_content, utm_term, expanded_url, display_url, currency. - Aggregate using SUM over r.clicks, r.impressions, r.spend, r.spend_micro, r.url_clicks, r.total_conversions, r.total_conversions_sale_amount. • SUM ignores NULL inputs; if all values in a group are NULL, the result is NULL. • No rounding or unit conversion is applied; spend is in currency units and spend_micro in micro-units of the same currency. - No de-duplication is performed; multiple matches on joins replicate metric rows and are then aggregated within identical dimension sets.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar day from r.date_day; defines the daily aggregation period.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: placement
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Inventory placement from r.placement; used as a grouping dimension.
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Twitter Ads account ID from r.account_id; used as a grouping dimension.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account display name from a.account_name; grouped and carried as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign ID from c.campaign_id via line_item → campaign; used as a grouping dimension; may be NULL.
      - name: campaign_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign name from c.campaign_name; grouped and carried as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: line_item_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Line item ID from li.line_item_id via pt.line_item_id; used as a grouping dimension; may be NULL.
      - name: line_item_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Line item name from li.line_item_name; grouped and carried as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: promoted_tweet_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Promoted tweet ID from r.promoted_tweet_id; used as a grouping dimension.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: tweet_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Underlying tweet ID from pt.tweet_id; non-NULL due to URL filter; used as a grouping dimension.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: tweet_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Tweet name label from t.tweet_name; grouped and carried as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: tweet_full_text
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full tweet text from t.tweet_full_text; grouped and carried as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: base_url
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Expanded URL without query string from u.base_url; grouped and carried as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: url_host
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Host component of the expanded URL from u.url_host; grouped and carried as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: url_path
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Path component of the expanded URL from u.url_path; grouped and carried as-is; may be NULL or empty.
      - name: utm_source
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: UTM source from u.utm_source; grouped and carried as-is; NULL if not present.
      - name: utm_medium
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: UTM medium from u.utm_medium; grouped and carried as-is; NULL if not present.
      - name: utm_campaign
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: UTM campaign from u.utm_campaign; grouped and carried as-is; NULL if not present.
      - name: utm_content
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: UTM content from u.utm_content; grouped and carried as-is; NULL if not present.
      - name: utm_term
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: UTM term from u.utm_term; grouped and carried as-is; NULL if not present.
      - name: expanded_url
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full expanded URL from u.expanded_url; non-NULL due to filter; used as a grouping dimension.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: display_url
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Display-friendly URL from u.display_url; grouped and carried as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: currency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign currency code from c.currency; grouped and carried as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of r.clicks within each dimension group; NULLs ignored; NULL if all values are NULL.
      - name: impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of r.impressions within each dimension group; NULLs ignored; NULL if all values are NULL.
      - name: spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of r.spend within each dimension group in currency units; NULLs ignored; NULL if all values are NULL.
      - name: spend_micro
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of r.spend_micro within each dimension group in micro-units; NULLs ignored; NULL if all values are NULL.
      - name: url_clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of r.url_clicks within each dimension group; NULLs ignored; NULL if all values are NULL.
      - name: total_conversions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of r.total_conversions within each dimension group; NULLs ignored; NULL if all values are NULL.
      - name: total_conversions_sale_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of r.total_conversions_sale_amount within each dimension group in currency units; NULLs ignored; NULL if all values are NULL.

- name: xero__invoice_line_items
      description: Invoice line items enriched with invoice-level non-negative metrics, shares, sequencing, and run timestamp
      grain: One row per input line with non-null invoice_id and line_item_id; duplicates preserved
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_xero__invoice_line_items_enriched
      business_logic: '- Source rows from intermediate.int_xero__invoice_line_items_enriched where both line_item_id and invoice_id are present. - Pass through descriptive, account, contact, tracking fields, and processed_at unchanged. - Standardize amounts and quantity: - line_amount_nonneg: if line_amount is null then null; if negative then 0; otherwise keep line_amount. - tax_amount_nonneg: if tax_amount is null then null; if negative then 0; otherwise keep tax_amount. - line_net_of_tax: line_amount minus tax_amount (treat missing tax_amount as 0); if result is negative then 0; if line_amount is null then null. - quantity: set to null when source quantity is null or negative; otherwise keep the source value. - Per invoice_id, compute: - invoice_gross_nonneg: sum of line_amount_nonneg (nulls ignored; null if all inputs are null). - invoice_net_nonneg: sum of line_net_of_tax (nulls ignored; null if all inputs are null). - invoice_line_count: number of lines after the ID filters (includes lines with null amounts). - Attach invoice-level totals back to each line. - Per-line shares (only when denominators are positive): - line_share_gross: line_amount_nonneg divided by invoice_gross_nonneg; otherwise null. - line_share_net: line_net_of_tax divided by invoice_net_nonneg; otherwise null. - Within each invoice_id, order lines by line_item_id ascending to compute: - invoice_cum_gross_nonneg: cumulative sum of line_amount_nonneg from the first ordered line through the current line. - line_seq_in_invoice: 1-based sequence in that order. If multiple lines share the same line_item_id within an invoice, their relative order is unspecified. - Classify line_item_type by line_amount: positive → Revenue; negative → Expense/Refund; zero or null → Neutral. - Set report_generated_at to the current timestamp at model execution. - Final result: one row per input line that passed the ID filters, ordered by invoice_id and line_seq_in_invoice ascending.'
      columns:
      - name: line_item_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Invoice line item identifier from source; NULLs are filtered out upstream
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: invoice_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Invoice identifier from source; NULLs are filtered out upstream
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: account_code
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Account code of the line item (numeric code from source)
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account name associated with the line item
      - name: account_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account type classification from source
      - name: account_class
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account class/category from source
      - name: description
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Free-text line description from source
      - name: quantity
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Quantity with guard: null if source quantity is null or negative; otherwise pass-through'
      - name: unit_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Unit price from source (pass-through; no rounding)
      - name: line_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Line amount from source (pass-through; may be negative or null)
      - name: tax_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Tax amount from source (pass-through; may be negative or null)
      - name: tax_type

        description: Tax type/code from source
      - name: discount_rate

      - name: contact_id

        description: Contact identifier associated with the invoice line
      - name: contact_name

        description: Contact name associated with the invoice line
      - name: region

      - name: project

        description: Class tracking dimension from source
      - name: customer
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer tracking dimension from source
      - name: cost_center
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Cost center tracking dimension from source
      - name: line_amount_nonneg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If line_amount is null then null; if negative then 0; otherwise equal to line_amount
      - name: tax_amount_nonneg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If tax_amount is null then null; if negative then 0; otherwise equal to tax_amount
      - name: line_net_of_tax
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Line amount minus tax (missing tax treated as 0), floored at 0; null if line_amount is null
      - name: invoice_gross_nonneg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of non-negative line amounts per invoice; ignores nulls; null if all inputs are null
      - name: invoice_net_nonneg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of non-negative net-of-tax amounts per invoice; ignores nulls; null if all inputs are null
      - name: invoice_line_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of lines per invoice after filtering out null line_item_id and invoice_id
      - name: line_share_gross
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Per-line proportion of invoice gross; computed only when invoice gross is > 0; otherwise null
      - name: line_share_net

      - name: invoice_cum_gross_nonneg

      - name: line_seq_in_invoice

        description: 1-based position within invoice ordered by line_item_id; tie order for duplicate line_item_id is unspecified
      - name: line_item_type

        description: 'Classification by line_amount sign: positive Revenue; negative Expense/Refund; otherwise Neutral (includes null and zero)'
      - name: processed_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: ETL processing timestamp from the source intermediate model
      - name: report_generated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Query run timestamp set at model execution time

- name: xero__profit_and_loss_report
      description: Monthly profit and loss summary by account and tracking dimensions with revenue/expense split, net, and a month-level cumulative net
      grain: One row per report_month per account_code per account_name per pl_category per pl_subcategory per region per department per project
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_xero__general_ledger_fact
      business_logic: '- Read journal lines from intermediate.int_xero__general_ledger_fact. - Derive calendar-based period fields from journal_date: fiscal_year (year), fiscal_month (month number 1–12), and fiscal_quarter (calendar quarter; used only in aggregation). - For each journal line: - revenue_amount = net_amount when account_class is REVENUE; otherwise 0. - expense_amount = absolute value of net_amount when account_class is EXPENSE; otherwise 0. - net_amount remains unchanged from source. - pl_category: - Revenue if account_class is REVENUE - Expenses if account_class is EXPENSE - Balance Sheet if account_class is ASSET, LIABILITY, or EQUITY - Other otherwise - pl_subcategory: - Operating Revenue if account_type is REVENUE - Operating Expenses if account_type is EXPENSE and account_code starts with "4" - Administrative Expenses if account_type is EXPENSE and account_code starts with "6" - Cost of Goods Sold if account_type is DIRECTCOSTS - Overhead if account_type is OVERHEADS - Depreciation if account_type is DEPRECIATN - Other otherwise - Aggregate monthly: - report_month = first day of the calendar month of journal_date. - Group by report_month, fiscal_year, fiscal_month, fiscal_quarter, account_code, account_name, pl_category, pl_subcategory, region, department, project. - Compute monthly_revenue = sum of revenue_amount, monthly_expenses = sum of expense_amount, monthly_net = sum of net_amount. - Produce final rows only where monthly_revenue is nonzero or monthly_expenses is nonzero; set period_type to "Monthly". - Output revenue = monthly_revenue, expenses = monthly_expenses, net_amount = monthly_net. - Compute cumulative_net within each report_month as a running total of monthly_net ordered alphabetically by pl_category, then by account_code ascending; when order keys tie, row order is nondeterministic. - Set report_generated_at to the execution timestamp (identical across rows within a run). - Order the final result by report_month descending, then by pl_category priority (Revenue first, Expenses second, then others), then by account_code ascending.'
      columns:
      - name: report_month
        data_type: DATE
        description: First calendar day of the month of journal_date
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: fiscal_year
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Calendar year of journal_date
      - name: fiscal_month
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Calendar month number (1–12) of journal_date
      - name: period_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Static period label; always 'Monthly'
      - name: pl_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Category from account_class: Revenue, Expenses, Balance Sheet, or Other'
      - name: pl_subcategory
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Detailed P&L subcategory from account_type and account_code prefix rules
      - name: account_code
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Numeric ledger account code used for grouping and ordering; prefix checks treat it as a string; ordered ascending
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ledger account name from source; included in the monthly grouping
      - name: revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Monthly sum of revenue_amount (net_amount for REVENUE lines, else 0); may be negative; nulls ignored in sums; zero allowed

- name: zuora__account_overview
      description: Account-level overview combining current account fields, current contact fields, invoice aggregates, and invoice item counts
      grain: One row per account_id present in int_zuora__account_current
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_zuora__account_current
      - intermediate.int_zuora__contact_current
      - intermediate.int_zuora__invoice_base
      - intermediate.int_zuora__invoice_item_base
      - intermediate.int_zuora__billing_enriched
      business_logic: '- Base: Start from intermediate.int_zuora__account_current (assumed one current row per account_id). - Contact: Left join intermediate.int_zuora__contact_current on account_id; if no contact row, all contact fields are NULL. - Invoice item count: - Build items_by_account by joining intermediate.int_zuora__invoice_base to intermediate.int_zuora__invoice_item_base on invoice_id, then counting distinct invoice_item_id per account_id. - Left join items_by_account to accounts. The count reflects distinct item IDs across all invoices of the account. If an account has invoices but none have items, the count is 0. If an account has no invoices, there is no items_by_account row and the joined count is NULL. - Invoice aggregates: - Build per_invoice by left joining intermediate.int_zuora__billing_enriched to intermediate.int_zuora__invoice_base on invoice_id, then grouping by account_id to compute: - first_charge_date: earliest non-NULL first_charge_date across the account’s invoices. - total_amount_paid: sum of invoice_amount_paid. - total_amount_not_paid: sum of invoice_amount_unpaid. - total_taxes: sum of tax_amount. - total_invoice_amount: sum of invoice_amount. - Summations skip NULL inputs per row; if an account has invoices but all values for a summed field are NULL, the result is NULL. If an account has no invoices, no per_invoice row exists and all joined aggregates are NULL. - Invoice count: - Compute per account_id using a correlated subquery over intermediate.int_zuora__invoice_base that counts distinct invoices; returns 0 when no invoices exist. - Output: - Select pass-through account fields, joined contact fields, per_invoice.first_charge_date as first_charge_processed_at, items_by_account.invoice_item_count, the scalar invoice_count, and the per_invoice totals. No zero-coalescing, rounding, or casting; all joins from accounts are left joins.'
      columns:

- name: zuora__monthly_recurring_revenue
      description: Monthly sums of recurring vs non-recurring invoice amounts per account using the current rate plan charge type.
      grain: One row per account_id and account_month (month of service_start_day)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_zuora__invoice_item_base
      - intermediate.int_zuora__rate_plan_charge_current
      business_logic: '- Inputs: - From intermediate.int_zuora__invoice_item_base: account_id, service_start_day, rate_plan_charge_id, charge_amount, discount_amount. - From intermediate.int_zuora__rate_plan_charge_current: rate_plan_charge_id, charge_type. - Build the month spine as distinct pairs of (account_id, month of service_start_day set to the first day). - Left join invoice items to the month spine on account_id and month; then left join the current rate plan charge on rate_plan_charge_id. - Classification for each invoice item: - Recurring (MRR): charge_type equals "recurring" when compared case-insensitively (no trimming). - Non-MRR: charge_type is present and, case-insensitively, not equal to "recurring". - If the rate plan charge is missing or charge_type is NULL, the item contributes 0 to both categories. - Per-line numeric handling: - charge_amount is converted to a DOUBLE; invalid or NULL values are treated as 0.0. - discount_amount treats NULL as 0.0; signs are preserved; no rounding or currency conversion. - If the rate plan charge join returns multiple matches for a line, that line’s amounts are counted multiple times. - Aggregations per (account_id, account_month): - Gross MRR: sum of charge_amount over recurring items. - Discount MRR: sum of discount_amount over recurring items. - Net MRR: sum over recurring items of (charge_amount minus discount_amount). - Gross non-MRR: sum of charge_amount over non-MRR items. - Discount non-MRR: sum of discount_amount over non-MRR items. - Net non-MRR: sum over non-MRR items of (charge_amount minus discount_amount). - Output includes every (account_id, account_month) from the month spine; if no items match a category, the corresponding sums are 0.0.'
      columns:
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier used for grouping.
      - name: account_month
        data_type: DATE
        description: Month derived from service_start_day, set to the first day of that month.
      - name: gross_current_month_mrr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of charge_amount (invalid or NULL treated as 0.0) for items classified as recurring (case-insensitive match to 'recurring').
      - name: discount_current_month_mrr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of discount_amount (NULL treated as 0.0) for items classified as recurring.
      - name: net_current_month_mrr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum over recurring items of charge_amount minus discount_amount with the same null handling.
      - name: gross_current_month_non_mrr
